Who I Am

A senior at the University of Oregon working where sports, brand, and data meet.

I'm majoring in Advertising with a minor in Sports Business, and I spend my time managing NIL brand partnerships for student-athletes — pairing them with the right brands and running the deals end to end as an Account Manager with the Oregon Accelerator.

Since June 2026 I've closed deals with brands including Momentous, GLD, Manta Sleep, Hawaiian Island Grill, Fore Seasons Golf Simulator, and R&A Mobile Detailing. My experience spans professional sports and brand strategy, with a growing focus on how AI and data are reshaping the way we understand fans, athletes, and markets.

What I Love

The business behind the game — how athletes build brands, how deals get made, and where technology takes it next.

7 deals closed across 6 brands since June 2026

Mikey Ebner

Pitcher · University of Oregon Baseball

Mikey is a pitcher for the University of Oregon baseball team. As his account manager through the Oregon Accelerator, I lead his NIL strategy — identifying brand fits, pitching partnerships, and managing each deal from first outreach through activation and content.

In four months we've built a lineup of six partners spanning performance nutrition, recovery, food, golf, and automotive — brands his audience actually cares about.

First Place · Winning Team

Kaiser Permanente × Oregon Accelerator

Thrive Where Life Takes You · Spring 2026
Hosted byOregon Accelerator

My team won first place developing a business case for Kaiser Permanente — a scalable campus-tour activation that gives a healthcare brand an authentic access point into NCAA marketing, anchored by NIL athletes to close the 45% primary-care gap among 18–29 year olds.

The real lessons were leadership, coordinating a team's strengths, and presenting under pressure — the parts that don't fit on a slide.
